modules.title: 点一下「金额」列头，看看什么变了

items.title: 排序换位置，不减数量
items.text: 按哪个字段排、从大到小还是从小到大，都只调整先后。列表还是那些记录，只是顺序变了。

items.title: 升序和降序
items.text: 升序是从小到大（1、2、3），降序是从大到小（3、2、1）。「最新的在最上面」通常就是按创建时间降序。

items.title: 默认排序要说清楚
items.text: 列表打开时的顺序就是默认排序。跟 AI 指定「默认按创建时间倒序」，能避免它随便给一个字母序。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 排序和筛选经常一起用：先筛出「跟进中」的，再按金额降序。「置顶」是另一回事——手动钉一条在最上面，其他记录顺序不动；跟 AI 说「置顶」它不会当排序做。

lessonPractice.title: 想看「金额最大的几条报价」，下面哪种操作不会减少列表里的记录数？

options.label: 按金额从大到小排序
options.feedback: 对。排序只调整先后，所有记录都还在，金额最大的排到最上面；想看前几条看前几行。

options.label: 筛选金额大于 10,000 的记录
options.feedback: 筛选会把不符合条件的记录藏起来，列表变短——数量变了，这是筛选不是排序。

options.label: 把金额小的记录删掉
options.feedback: 删除直接减少数据本身，代价是记录没了；看排序不该用删除实现。

en.title: To see "the largest quotes," which operation does NOT reduce the number of records in the list?

options.label: Sort by amount, largest first
options.feedback: Correct. Sorting only reorders—every record stays, the largest ones move to the top.

options.label: Filter to records above 10,000
options.feedback: Filtering hides non-matching records and shortens the list—the count changes. That is filtering, not sorting.

options.label: Delete the small-amount records
options.feedback: Deleting removes the data itself. Viewing order should never be built on deletion.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 报价列表的金额列可以点击切换从大到小和从小到大，其他列不动。改完我在手机上点一遍金额列头，确认顺序在变、记录条数不变。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Make the amount column clickable to toggle largest-first and smallest-first, leaving other columns alone. After the change, I will tap the amount header on mobile to confirm the order changes while the record count stays the same.

learning.assumes: You have sorted photos by time or clicked a table column header.
learning.outcome: You can turn "I want X on top" into "sort by field ascending/descending," and tell sorting from filtering.

modules.title: Tap the amount header and watch what changes
What sorting and filtering each cover

items.title: Ascending and descending
items.text: Ascending goes small to large (1, 2, 3); descending goes large to small (3, 2, 1). "Newest on top" is creation time descending.

items.title: State the default sort
items.text: The order on open is the default sort. Specifying "newest by creation time" keeps the AI from picking an arbitrary alphabetical order.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Sorting is not filtering: filtering narrows the list, sorting reorders it without losing a record—they often combine, filtering "following up" then sorting by amount. Pinning a row to the top is also not sorting; it manually pins one record and leaves the rest untouched.

distinctions.label: Filter
distinctions.text: {c:filter} hides non-matching records and shortens the list; {c:sort} reorders records without losing any.

distinctions.label: Search
distinctions.text: {c:search} finds records matching keywords; {c:sort} arranges the found records by a field.
